objective: An admin menu for the game's owner (and anyone in Studio) to spawn any animal's model, or all of them in a row, play each animation on them and clear them.
acceptance_criteria: The Admin button shows only for a player the server marks as admin
Every admin request is refused on the server for a player who is not an admin
Spawning all stands sixteen models in a row in front of the admin, and the animation buttons play on them
Nothing the menu does changes a saved profile
verification: 2026-11-13: lune 659/659, stylua and selene clean. Studio play (stations.rbxl, synced from source): the player was marked admin and the Admin button showed; its list has a spawn button for each of the 16 animals plus one for all; 'spawn all' stood 16 models in a row in front of the player; 'walk' set every one walking; an index that does not exist was refused by the server. No script errors. Not checked: a live server, where only the owning account is admin (Studio makes everyone admin), so a non-admin being refused was not seen in play.
notes: Display only, no rules or saved data: no headless test. The admin check is on the server (the owning user's id, or Studio).
